provenance: Original synthetic teaching cases; no observed company data or estimated fair values.
units: Money in kCU (thousands of currency units); shares in thousands; prices and par in CU per share. Exact rational strings.
time: Fictional year X1. Group control begins 1 January; events follow listed order through 31 December. Share case is a separate company with its own ordered dates.
conventions: Debit-positive ledgers; ordinary residual common equity. No tax, OCI, FX, transaction costs, impairment, share retirement, options or preference shares. Group uses proportionate NCI, acquisition-date identifiable fair values equal supplied carrying amounts, unchanged nondepreciable land, no goodwill amortization or impairment in this case, and separate-parent cost investment/dividend-income convention. All dividends declared and paid on their stated date; external liabilities unchanged.

event_order: 1 January: acquire existing shares from outside sellers; subsidiary receives no consideration
30 June: parent cash services and operating payments
1 July: parent buys batch for cash then transfers it on credit to subsidiary
30 September: subsidiary sells stated fraction for cash and pays operating costs
1 October: subsidiary settles part of intercompany payable
1 November: subsidiary declares and pays dividend
1 December: parent declares and pays dividend
31 December: close company income and dividends; prepare consolidation worksheet
